old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a fire burning on a rough, dark surface, likely concrete or asphalt. The flames are vivid and dynamic, with bright orange and yellow hues dominating the scene. The fire engulfs several pieces of paper, which are visibly crumpled and torn, indicating they have been deliberately set ablaze. As the fire burns, the paper begins to char and blacken, with some parts curling up and others melting into ash. A pink ribbon is also visible, partially engulfed by the flames, adding a contrasting color to the predominantly fiery scene. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing tightly on the fire and the burning materials, providing a detailed and immersive view of the combustion process. The background remains consistent, emphasizing the intensity and immediacy of the fire.

caption: The video captures an overhead close-up of a small fire already burning on dark, charred ground. A flattened cardboard box sits center-left, engulfed in bright orange-yellow flames, while crumpled white tissues lie around it, their edges browning and curling. A small pink scrap with a tiny flame rests at the top center beside a vertical trail of white ash, and rough blackened earth dotted with pale ash fills the right. Throughout the excerpt the flames flicker and change height, and the framing drifts slightly so the box edges toward the left. Near the middle a hand enters from the bottom-left holding a fresh, mostly-white folded sheet and lays it onto the burning box. The newly placed sheet catches fire as its edges darken and flames climb over it. The pink scrap and ash trail remain in place, their small flame only flickering.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
